notes.title: Development and future update QC
notes.notes:
Ok... wow, WHAT A JOURNEY!

This has been alot of work but I won't lie it has been fun! This project has gone so much further than I could have ever imagined. There have been ups and downs - from "Can I even achieve this vision?" to major moments of excitement when things come together.

All that being said... Does the game have some issues? Yes, absolutely. I'm not going to pretend there aren't things that need some work. I, as a developer, have a duty to better quality check my product before updates and expansions. I pledge to dedicate more time to ensure quality over quantity for updates. Updates might take a little bit more time but that definitely beats broken and buggy gameplay.

It's true that I created this game around the weapons, features, mechanics that I like but that does NOT mean the community has no say in what can be put in the game or changed in terms of gameplay mechanics.

Please visit the Discord or post here what you would like to see in future updates, such as weapons, features, locations, modes, or bugs. I value all feedback and I take all player feedback very seriously.

HotFix v.23++

Added electricution animation to zombies for the electric trap. Here's how the trap works. The trap does set amount of damage. It does not tick. So if a the trap does example 100 damage and zombie health is 90 the zombie will immediatly die with No shock animation. If the zombies health is 110 it will take his health to 10 play the animation and stick him there for the duration of the trap. when the trap is over the zombies movement will resume.
